meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 引导新用户完成 omo 的首次设置：介绍功能亮点，可协助从其他编程助手迁移配置；经同意后分析旧会话并给出量化节省估算；全程记录用户偏好，最后提出运行 init-deep 的建议。
howto.when: 当新用户要求开始使用 omo 时触发；该技能只会自动启动一次，之后可由 `senpi --onboard` 重新唤起。

say.text: 我第一次用 omo，请带我完成入门设置。
say.note: 触发完整的 onboarding 引导流程。

say.text: 我想从 Claude Code 迁移我的配置。
say.note: 会询问源配置并给出迁移计划，须你确认后再执行。

say.text: 帮我分析过去的使用记录，估算能省多少费用。
say.note: 需你允许查看历史会话，然后给出量化估算。

howto.what_en: Runs the first conversation with a new omo user: a feature tour, optional migration help from other agents, optional session-history analysis with quantified savings estimates, continuous memory recording of user facts, and a final init-deep proposal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo (their first conversation). Auto-starts once ever; can be reopened anytime with `senpi --onboard`.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo — please walk me through the initial setup.
I'd like to migrate my configuration from Claude Code.
Look at my past coding sessions and estimate savings.
say_en.note: Needs your permission to inspect history, then gives quantified figures.
